passage.title: A QUIET WEEKEND BY THE SEA
passage.subtitle: Nadia's short trip to Brighton
paragraphs: Last Friday afternoon, Nadia and her husband Karim took a one-hour train from London to Brighton for a quiet weekend by the sea. They booked a cosy room on the top floor of a white guesthouse overlooking the water.

On Saturday morning, the sky was bright blue, though the sea wind was a little cool. After eating toast, eggs and fresh fruit at the guesthouse, they walked along the famous pier and took lots of photos of the colourful beach huts.

At lunchtime, they found a small seafood restaurant near the harbour and ate grilled fish with chips and lemon. In the afternoon, Karim wanted to visit the museum, while Nadia bought two handmade postcards and a wool scarf at a small craft shop.
Before taking the Sunday evening train back to London, they sat on the pebbles watching the orange sunset. Both of them agreed that two days by the sea felt just like a full week's holiday.
